title: Lyhanna Death Protests Spread to Justice Ministry and Courthouses
detail: New rallies took place Monday evening outside France's justice ministry and regional courts over the death of Lyhanna, with protests continuing to spread across France. The demonstrations reflect growing public anger over the case and demands for accountability from the justice system.

title: G7 at Évian: Macron's Global Activism Tested by Domestic Political Fragility
detail: As France hosts the G7 summit at Évian-les-Bains, President Macron's diplomatic ambitions on the world stage are being put to the test by his fragile domestic political position. Analysts note the tension between his assertive international posture and his weakened standing within France's fractured parliament.

title: French Parliament Approves Restitution of Six Amerindians' Remains Displayed in Human Zoos
detail: The French Parliament voted to return the remains of six Amerindians from French Guiana who had been exhibited in so-called 'human zoos' during the colonial era. The landmark restitution measure represents a significant acknowledgment of colonial-era abuses and a step toward reparative justice for indigenous communities from French Guiana.
